verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own docs show it is headless and programmatically driven: an official SDK controls headless browsers, a Browse CLI keeps agents working in the terminal, and agents can be deployed to run on a schedule or on demand. No evidence pack item shows running it inside a CI pipeline, so coverage is partial rather than complete. missing for 10: explicit CI integration documentation (e.g. CI pipeline examples or guides), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI automation use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
